mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE org_id = #{orgId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customers (org_id, name, email, phone) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE customers SET name = #{name}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND org_id = #{orgId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM customers WHERE id = #{id} AND org_id = #{orgId}
